pages.observation: The page goes from Ananya's consultation (p4) back to Meera with no marker of time or place, so the reader can't tell if this is after the visit. Ravi's 'one place' question is an inference that 'stay connected with their care' doesn't quite set up. Meera offers to walk Ravi through the app, but that never appears; the page cuts to a closing caption. The label at the bottom-left of panel 2 is read after Ravi's question and before Meera's answer. That works, but it splits the exchange. No unreadable text.
